stem.text: For which reaction will the major organic product have the lowest relative molecular mass?

A.text: Bromoethane is heated under reflux with an aqueous solution of sodium hydroxide.

B.text: Bromoethane is heated under reflux with a solution of sodium cyanide in ethanol.

C.text: 2-bromopropane is heated under reflux with an aqueous solution of sodium hydroxide.

D.text: 2-bromopropane is heated under reflux with concentrated ethanolic sodium hydroxide.
